method: Each official document was downloaded over verified HTTPS, converted to text (scanned AYBÜ pages read as images) and the formula, passing grade and committee list/weights were compared with the export by hand. Thresholds the calculator does not model (final minimums, per-committee minimums, exemptions) are noted but not applied.
